assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of ALGOL 68 Compiler for the DEC PDP11 Computers and inspected the cited passage (ALGOL Bulletin 42, printed p. 3, PDP11 compiler notice, third paragraph (archive AB42.1.3, printed heading AB41.1.3)). AB42 page 3 explicitly identifies ALGOL 68 as the parent of the official subset called ALGOL 68S, while describing the PDP11 input as an extension of that subset.

challenge.method: Compare the full language, the official subset, and the extended compiler’s features beyond full ALGOL 68. Read Hibbard §0.2 as a direction check.
challenge.results: The notice and Hibbard’s addendum support the subset-to-full-language direction for the formal specification. The extended language’s extra features fall outside that edge.

limitations: The parent relation concerns the IFIP subset with the name supplied by the notice.
